messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert - runtime queueing spike detected for hosted inference (region:east-us). Errors + tail latency increasing. Auto-shed triggered on some tenants. Metrics: inflight=9800, queue_len=3200, 5xx_rate=3.4%

sam (oncall): Acknowledged. Paging in runtime oncall (jess) and SRE. Marking incident on-call.

jess (runtime): I see a sudden burst from a small set of customers hitting long sequences + embeddings route. Probable hot path: embed route holding KV cache and blocking worker slots.

maria (sre): Confirmed. Node mem pressure on a subset of workers, pod restarts starting to tick. Suggest immediate traffic shaping and reduce max_inflight for embed-heavy routes.

kevin (support): Noted customer-facing impact: 3 active customers reporting slow responses (cust-A, cust-B, cust-C). I can DM them with high-level mitigation note once we have a stable plan.

jess (runtime): Plan: 1) Temporarily lower max_inflight for /embed routes to 6 2) Enable soft-shedding at 30% on non-critical tenants 3) Disable experimental streaming-embed feature flag 4) Increase per-tenant rate-limit for internal infra to avoid CI failures. Applying sequentially — will announce each change.

sam (oncall): Go for it. Prefer non-disruptive first (soft-shed), then hard caps if needed. Keep me posted.

jess (runtime): Running command to set soft-shed and max_inflight for embed route:
```bash
redwoodctl routes update --route embed --max_inflight 6 --soft_shed 30
```
Applying...

deploy-bot: config-change: routes/embed updated by jess (runtime) at 6123456832.

jess (runtime): Change applied. Observing metrics: inflight=7600 -> 5400 (3m), queue_len=3200 -> 1200 (3m)

maria (sre): Doing traffic-shaping on the ingress tier to rate-limit noisy tenants: `iptables` token-bucket patch applied to east-us-ingress; effective now.

kevin (support): Customer update: messaged cust-A + cust-B with mitigation note, asking for any blocking jobs they can rerun. cust-C is ok to throttle for now.

sam (oncall): Any sign of error rate dropping?

jess (runtime): 5xx_rate down from 3.4% -> 1.1% (10m). Tail latency p95 dropped ~45%. Still some backlog but trending good.

maria (sre): I see several worker pods still OOM-killed; started a rolling restart for the worst nodes and bumped memory limit on the embed workers by 10% as hotfix.

jess (runtime): Disabled streaming-embed feature flag (ff_embed_stream=false) to reduce concurrency pressure. command: `featurectl toggle ff_embed_stream off --env prod`

deploy-bot: feature-flag change recorded by jess at 6123456865.

kevin (support): Will include the flag toggle in the customer message update.

sam (oncall): Any collateral impact from disabling the streaming flag? Will it increase token cost or latencies for normal traffic?

jess (runtime): Slight latency increase for some long-running embed ops but overall system stability prioritized. We can revert once we scale nodes.

maria (sre): Queue length now 400, inflight 2200, 5xx_rate 0.5% (20m). Solid improvement.

sam (oncall): Good. Start handoff notes for next shift: summarize actions and owners.

jess (runtime): Handoff notes (brief): - Applied soft-shed 30% to embed route (jess) - max_inflight embed -> 6 (jess) - Disabled ff_embed_stream (jess) - Ingress token-bucket shaping applied (maria) - Rolling restart + memory bump for worst nodes (maria) - Customer comms sent (kevin) - Monitor for CI rate-limit regressions (sam)

kevin (support): Customers acknowledged mitigation, cust-A reduced batch sizes, cust-B queued jobs for later. No further escalations.

sam (oncall): Closing mitigation plan. Please open follow-up runbook ticket to: 1) evaluate better per-tenant fairshare, 2) add alert for streaming-embed memory increases, 3) plan capacity add for embed workers. Assign to jess + maria.

jess (runtime): Will open RFC/issue. Quick note: recommend reviewing auto-scaling thresholds for embed queue depth and adding a per-tenant circuit-breaker.

ops-bot: Incident mitigated - system stabilized. Marking as resolved for live mitigation. Follow-up ticket: RDW-INC-1274 created by sam. :white_check_mark:

sam (oncall): Thanks everyone. Leave this thread for postmortem notes. :thumbsup:
